context-mcp is a long-lived stdio process, so Ruby interpreter startup is paid once per
session rather than per call -- unlike the hook path, where startup sits inside a one-
second timeout. It still loads only the mcp gem and this package: no Rails, no database
driver, no HTTP client. STDOUT is reserved for MCP protocol messages; diagnostics go to
stderr and their verbosity is set with KIOKU_LOG_LEVEL.
The server holds no storage authority. Every tool call is forwarded to context-agent over
the private Unix socket at KIOKU_SOCKET_PATH, so context-agent must be running for a tool
